subject: Acme Analytics - Marketplace inquiry & intro/demo

From: Olivia Park <olivia@acme-analytics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Analytics - Interested via Cloud Marketplace

Hi Ben,

We came across Redwood's listing on the cloud marketplace and are interested in a short intro/demo to understand how Redwood's inference platform could fit into our stack. We're evaluating options for hosting low-latency models for customer-facing features and want to compare cost and deployment flexibility (hosted vs. dedicated).

Our initial use case: real-time ranking + reranking for recommendations (~150 qps peak, avg 20 tokens/request). Key concerns: latency SLA, cost per token, and SOC2 evidence.

Potential times next week (PST): Tue 2/16 morning, Wed 2/17 afternoon, or Thu 2/18 any time.

I've attached a short RFP doc with a few more details.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics
olivia@acme-analytics.com
Attachment: acme-rfp.pdf (application/pdf)

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Hi Olivia — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for submitting the RFP. I'd love to set up a 30-minute intro + demo to show throughput/latency characteristics and discuss Dedicated options and SOC2 artifacts.

A few quick questions before the call so we can tailor the demo:
- Primary SLAs you need (p50/p95 latency targets)?
- Are you evaluating for hosted first or looking straight to Dedicated/private?
- Any specific integrations (GCP marketplace billing, KMS) we should prepare for?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2/16 9:00-9:30am
- Wed 2/17 2:30-3:00pm
- Thu 2/18 11:00-11:30am

Or feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/30min

Attaching a short demo agenda and what we'll cover. I'll loop in Camila (solutions) to cover architecture and Marissa (marketplace ops) for any marketplace/contract questions.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191
